about: Service registry for make_film.py. Each service is one script with one job, talking to the others only through files in the film folder. make_film.py runs a pipeline from this file and skips a service when its outputs are newer than its inputs and its command is unchanged. Paths: {film} = the film folder, {engine} = <project>/engine, {build} = {film}/build. Inputs and outputs may use * globs. on_fail: stop (default) or warn.

voice-cache.does: Copies a saved voice (vo-<voice id>/) into vo/ so no credits are spent again

voice-elevenlabs.does: Narration from ElevenLabs, with native word timestamps

voice-sapi.does: Free local Windows voice with native word timings, for timing drafts

voice-import.does: Any other voice (Fish Audio, OpenAI, Azure, a recording): one file per line; timings given or estimated

align.does: Replaces estimated word timings with ones measured from the audio (faster-whisper word timestamps)
align.warn: word timings stay estimated; animations may land up to ~0.6 s off their words

timeline.does: Lays the lines on the film's timeline: cues.js for the picture and the score, and the voice track

score.does: The film's music bed, accents on the same beats as the picture

score-accents.does: The score's accents alone (score.js with BED=none), laid over a supplied music file

music-file.does: A music bed from a file the client supplies: trimmed to the film, faded in and out (looped if short)

mix.does: Levels the voice, the score (or a supplied bed plus the score's accents), ducks the music under the voice, normalises loudness

render.does: Draws every frame in headless Chrome and encodes the video with the mix

captions.does: Captions (.srt) from the narration's word timings

attach-captions.does: Puts the captions into the MP4 as a switchable subtitle track (not burned in)

intro.does: Builds the intro from its description (<film>/intro/, made by new_film.py) as a small film of its own, with the film's voice and loudness

outro.does: Builds the outro from its description (<film>/outro/, made by new_film.py) as a small film of its own, with the film's voice and loudness

bookends.does: Joins intro + film + outro (built from a description, or clips the client supplied in <film>/bookends/) into the delivered MP4, with one caption track across all three

deliver.does: Copies the rendered video to the delivery path (a film without captions)

check.does: Delivery checks: video, loudness, timings, captions, bookends, end-card time, alpha rule
check.warn: check_film.py found a FAIL: fix it before delivery

pipelines._variants: make_film.py adjusts a pipeline: --music FILE adds score-accents and music-file before mix; bookends (an intro or outro folder, or clips in bookends/) replace attach-captions or deliver with intro, outro, bookends; --captions none drops captions and attach-captions.
